global_flags.description: List of single-character flags from the synopsis (-c, -e, -g, -n, -r, -s, -t). Empty list defaults to no flags.

zip_archive.description: The path to the zip archive to be modified.

input_offset.description: The byte offset where ziptool should start reading the input archive (corresponds to -o).

input_length.description: The number of bytes to read from the input archive starting at offset (corresponds to -l). 0 means read until EOF.

commands.description: A list of command objects to execute. See items definition below.

commands.items.description: A single command definition. Must contain 'command' and optionally 'args'. See flat field definitions below.

commands.items.command.description: The ziptool command to run (e.g., add, delete, rename, set_archive_comment).

commands.items.args.description: Arguments for the command, passed as space-separated string values.
